title: 8019 Bella Charca Parkway Nolanville, TX FOR SALE: Lauren L. Reider-Hallmark, Realtor (254)291-0515
description: Agent- Lauren Reider-Hallmark (254)291-0515. Stunning sophistication abounds in this newly constructed modern take on Mediterranean craftsmanship located in beautifully maintained, park-like Bella Charca. This home features the quality of craftsmanship we have come to expect from Cameo Homes and offers a floorplan that embraces large, open spaces. Designed for gathering, the living, kitchen and dining are combined as one shared, cohesive space while separate formal living and dining areas offer a more intimate alternative for entertaining. An endless list of upgrades such as knotty Alder custom cabinets, gorgeous granite, gas stove, floor to ceiling limestone fireplace, wood etched stained concrete, oversized wood slim line glass doors to patio, radiant barrier roof decking, R-15 wall Batts insulation, built to exceed TEX-VET HERS rating specifications and so much more make this home one of the most impressive, amenity filled homes on the market! Full features list and floor plan are included for your convenience. Touring this home will be well worth your time and should be on the top of you “must see” list!
